final_text: Campaign complete — all specs finalized. **dds_250msps**: I spent the full 400-eval L1 budget on the structured DSE graph, which mapped a 34-design feasible Pareto front dominated by pipelined CORDIC designs (all at 264 MSPS, comfortably above the 250 MSPS constraint). L2 system simulation (no system scenario, but DDS spectral check ran) confirmed the top pick with SFDR 100.5 dBc and SNR 88.6 dB, selection unchanged. L3–L5 via the ladder subagent found no recorded RTL-verification or synthesis rows for this exact configuration (the RTL generator is independently verified on 47 configs as partial de-risk), so back_annotate returned no_measured_data and no winner change was flagged. Finalized selection: `pipelined:data_width=20, n_iter=15, angle_guard=-1, frac_guard=0, rounding=round` — 964 LUTs (estimate), 999 FFs, 13.3-bit accuracy (max_abs_err 9.65e-05, under the 2^-13 limit), 264 MSPS throughput.
